about: The tunes the game's music plays on sampled instruments (decision 815, later note). Each tune: role, departure for a departure melody (decision 853: levelled with the station chimes, not the music; absent for the music); copyright, whose the composition or arrangement is (the files it makes carry it in the manifest); loop, the seamless loop it makes (ALAC CAF), once, the file of it played once through that rings out at its end (AAC), either or both; reverb, the room's share; phraseBars, how many bars a phrase is (its notes swell to its middle); stems, by stem score, one entry for each track of that score, in order. program: a General MIDI program (melodic, bank 0), played by the chamber bank (chamber.json: the piano, the pizzicato, the harp and the slow strings, recorded) where it has it and by this bank otherwise; volume is matched to the level each track had on this bank alone, transpose: semitones added to its notes; drum: a note of the GS standard kit on channel 10, every note of the track played as it; synth: the track is played by make_game_audio.py's own voice (the rail joints), at that level. volume and pan are MIDI controllers 7 and 10; looseness, milliseconds the notes sit off the beat (a standard deviation); pedal, beats the sustain pedal holds from each bar's first beat.
